title: Fuel tape return
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $m$ be either Boolean mode. Choose a host base configuration, an input-head position, a flag tape, a counter word, and an output word. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |w|$, a host configuration in phase $3$ whose counter tape stores $w$, whose payload tape is blank, and whose counter and payload heads are both at $j-1$ reaches, after $j+1$ steps, phase $4$ with the same counter word and output, a blank payload tape, and both heads at zero.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
